UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile, universal character appearance, and synced game settings.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player display name shown in menus and multiplayer.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Authentication.

legacyLocalUid.description: Pre-login persistent local player ID migrated to this Firebase account.

appearance.description: Universal character appearance settings shared across worlds.

settings.description: Player HUD, audio, and camera preferences.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user's private email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was last updated.

CloudWorldSave.title: CloudWorldSave
CloudWorldSave.description: Authoritative cloud save of a player's procedural open world.

worldId.description: Unique identifier of the world save.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who owns this world.

seedText.description: Original text representation of the seed.

playerLevel.description: Current level of the host player in this world.

exploredChunksCount.description: Number of explored chunks preserved in this save.

gameVersion.description: Game version string that last saved this world.

checksum.description: FNV-1a integrity checksum of the save payload.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client epoch timestamp (ms) when the world was saved.

savePayload.description: Compacted WorldSaveData object containing metadata, player, chunks, creatures, waypoints, and structures.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud world save was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud world save was last updated.

CloudGuestProfile.title: CloudGuestProfile
CloudGuestProfile.description: Cloud backup of a player's guest character state in a multiplayer world hosted by another player.

worldId.description: ID of the multiplayer world where the guest played.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the guest player.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client epoch timestamp (ms) when the guest profile was saved.

playerPayload.description: Serialized PlayerState for the guest character.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the guest profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the guest profile was last updated.

UserEntitlement.title: UserEntitlement
UserEntitlement.description: Server-granted purchase, cosmetic pack, or exclusive item linked to the authenticated UID.

entitlementId.description: Unique identifier of the entitlement or purchase.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account that owns this entitlement.

sku.description: Product SKU or exclusive content identifier.

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entitlement was granted.

CloudWorldChunk.title: CloudWorldChunk
CloudWorldChunk.description: Individual modified chunk document belonging to a saved world in Cloud Firestore.

chunkKey.description: Chunk coordinate identifier (e.g., surface_0_0 or underground_0_0).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the world owner.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client epoch timestamp (ms) when this chunk was saved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Root player profile document indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection storing private account details such as email.

/users/{userId}/worlds/{worldId}/chunks/.description: Modified chunks subcollection belonging to a saved world.

/users/{userId}/guestProfiles/{worldId}.description: Player's guest character saves in external multiplayer worlds.

/users/{userId}/entitlements/{entitlemen.description: Read-only server-granted purchases and exclusive content tied to the player's UID.
